artifacts.summary: All 8 phases completed: consolidated duplicated build helpers, extracted _recheck_family, split the pinned evaluator into family-only/target-time groups, restructured the harness into a family-outer/target-inner loop, and measured a 72.2% (3.59x) reduction on the widest boxed case (121.78s -> 33.90s) and 60.2% (2.51x) on the second (17.93s -> 7.14s) under CI's exact shape, with counts unchanged. Phase 7's scheduled-run contingency was not taken (gate found the post-fix 88.7% headroom adequate).
